answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article published 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s late June 2026 announcement; the original NN release is not in the record, so its exact date is unknown.
answer.note: Material source claim: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN said 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and it targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. For NVDA, this is a supply-chain lead: it points to added Asian capacity aimed at NVIDIA-rack liquid cooling, which could support NVIDIA's rack build-out if the awards are tied to NVIDIA programs. It does not show NVIDIA as the buyer, the award volumes, or NVIDIA's own demand. The US$80–US$90 million figure is a company target and forward-looking, not a reported result. The NN Russell index removal and the analyst revenue projections concern NN itself and do not inform NVDA, so they are not used here.
limitations: The customers behind the pre-sold multi-year awards are not identified, so NVIDIA as direct buyer is not established.
The source gives no award volumes, unit counts, pricing or NVIDIA share of NN's revenue.
The US$80–US$90 million 2026 target is a company party statement with no stated basis or confirmation of achievement.
The NN original announcement and its statement date are not in the record; only the 2026-07-01 publication date is known.
No NVIDIA-side record confirms or describes this supplier relationship.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or SEC filing to confirm the 47 machine centers, the Wuxi location and the pre-sold claim, and to identify any named customers.
Check NN's subsequent 10-Q or 10-K for disclosed customer concentration and whether NVIDIA or NVIDIA-linked customers are named.
Check NVIDIA's annual filings or supplier disclosures for references to liquid cooling suppliers or Asian rack-assembly partners.
